Bid Opportunities

Thank you for wanting to work with "The Corporation of the District of Saanich", Vancouver Island's largest municipality!

Listed below are Saanich's current bid opportunities.

All documents, addendums and extensions for each bid opportunity are posted on the Saanich Procurement Portal: District of Saanich (bonfirehub.ca)

Vendors are responsible to acquire all documents, addendums, appendices and/or attachments prior to the closing date.  

Please prepare and submit all responses as outlined in the bid opportunity on the Saanich Procurement Portal: District of Saanich (bonfirehub.ca).

It is highly recommended that vendors begin their submission a day or two beforehand in case of system issues.

Please send all questions in writing to purchase@saanich.ca
